confusables.note: spectacular صفت است به معنای چشمگیر و تماشایی، در حالی که spectacle اسم است

homograph.note: The plural "spectacles" meaning eyeglasses is not guessable from the singular sense of an impressive public sight, and only the plural carries it. A hint must say which sense it targets; the exam tested the public-sight sense.

senses.definition: an unusual or impressive sight or public event that many people watch

examples.en: The opening ceremony was a spectacle that no one could forget.
examples.fa: مراسم افتتاحیه نمایشی بود که هیچ‌کس نمی‌توانست فراموشش کند.

senses.definition: a pair of glasses worn to help someone see better, used only in the plural "spectacles"

examples.en: He cleaned his spectacles carefully before reading the letter.
examples.fa: پیش از خواندن نامه، عینکش را با دقت تمیز کرد.
